title: Publish a stable module facade
summary: Re-export a public type from a private implementation module, then use the facade without exposing the internal module path.

module.clue: Keyword declaring the private implementation module internal

visible.clue: Visibility keyword making Ticket eligible for a public re-export

function.clue: Keyword defining the constructor function new

selfType.clue: Type spelling referring to Ticket inside its implementation

reexport.clue: Keywords making an imported item part of the api module’s public facade

current.clue: Path prefix locating internal relative to the api module

import.clue: Keyword bringing the facade’s Ticket type into the crate-root scope

equal.clue: Macro checking a ticket issued through the facade
